meta.title: Entre Tapas · Proper tapas in Les Roquetes
meta.description: Tapas, fried squid, croquettes and paella on Carrer de Roger de Flor, 100, Les Roquetes (Sant Pere de Ribes). Traditional cooking, a family welcome. Book: 628 00 96 23.

hero.eyebrow: Les Roquetes · Sant Pere de Ribes
hero.title: Real tapas, served with care
hero.lede: Fried squid, croquettes, the day's stew and paella. Traditional cooking made to order, in a bar where Esteve and his team look after you like family.

roast.title: A tapas bar, not a restaurant with a long menu
roast.lead: The point is to order several things and share them. Familiar dishes, made to order, and a menu that does not pretend to reinvent anything.

menu.title: What there is to pick at
menu.lead: The classics people order again and again, going by what the reviews say.

m1.name: Fried squid
m1.note: The classic that never misses: light batter, fried to order.

m3.name: The day's stew
m3.note: Whatever is cooked that day; it changes with the market.

m4.name: Paella
m4.note: Rice with seafood, for anyone wanting a main course.

m6.name: Tapas to share
m6.note: The natural way to eat here: several plates in the middle.

menu.note: No prices on this page: call or message and we will tell you what is on today.
